name: Insight
description: Decision-input integrity for onchain AI agents: is the price or action trustworthy before it is signed? Oracle-manipulation-aware PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdicts, pre-signing guard families (lending, perps, swaps) on Base, Monad, multichain EVM, Solana, and Hyperliquid, 24h Oracle Watch windows and Position Lifecycle bundles, with verifiable EIP-712 attestations. Pay-per-call: $0.02 per C3 decision USDC via x402 v2 on Base, Polygon PoS, Arbitrum One, Monad, HyperEVM, BNB Chain, or Solana mainnet, or via MPP; settlement happens only after the check succeeds. Endpoint is MCP over Streamable HTTP.

extensions.description: Supports payments using the x402 protocol for on-chain settlement. Every paid call returns an HTTP 402 challenge advertising USDC acceptance on eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum One), eip155:143 (Monad), eip155:999 (HyperEVM), eip155:56 (BNB Chain via AEON) and solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (Solana mainnet).

skills.name: Pre-trade safety check
skills.description: Oracle-manipulation-aware PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict for a single trade (asset, chainId, action, tradeAmountUsd). Returns consensus price, max deviation %, manipulation-risk score and provider quorum; optionally a verifiable EIP-712 attestation. $0.02 USDC via x402 v2 or MPP, settled only after success.
examples: Before my agent swaps USDC for ETH on Base, tell it whether the price feed it just read is currently trustworthy
Check whether swapping 1000 USD of ETH on mainnet is exposed to oracle manipulation
Get a manipulation-risk verdict before executing a trade

skills.name: Execution preflight
skills.description: Chain-neutral ALLOW/CAUTION/BLOCK data-sufficiency decision for one declared action over the strict oracle assessment and an optional fresh venue quote. A supplied decision-input quote is required for ALLOW. $0.02 USDC via x402 v2, settled only after success.
examples: My agent has a swap intent and a fresh venue quote — is the decision input sufficient to proceed?
Decide allow/caution/block for borrowing USDC against WETH on Monad before signing

skills.name: Lending guards (Base, Monad, multichain EVM, Solana)
skills.description: Read-only, pre-signing ALLOW/CAUTION/BLOCK decisions for one direct lending call: Aave V3, Morpho Blue, Compound V3, Moonwell (Base); Aave V3, Morpho Blue (Monad); Aave V3, Venus Core, Lista Moolah, Compound V3, Dolomite, Euler v2, Fluid T1 (Polygon/Arbitrum/BNB/Base); Kamino, Marginfi v2, Jupiter Lend, Save, Loopscale (Solana). Validate one unsigned Kamino deposit instruction before my Solana agent submits it

skills.name: Perp guards (Base Synthetix V3, Hyperliquid)
skills.description: Pre-trade decision-input integrity gates for opening a perp position: Synthetix Perps V3 on Base (oracle integrity for underlying and USDC margin, leverage vs reviewed market caps) and Hyperliquid HyperCore orders (underlying oracle integrity, leverage vs margin requirements, exact unsigned exchange-envelope binding). POST may return an EIP-712 decision attestation; never signs or broadcasts an order. $0.02 USDC per complete decision.
examples: My agent wants to open a 5x ETH long on Hyperliquid — is the price input trustworthy and is the leverage safe?
Check the oracle evidence for a Synthetix Perps V3 ETH long before the commitOrder call is signed

Verify the quoted price impact and TWAP for a 0.25 WETH→USDC swap before signing
